aria-hidden only hides content from assistive tech, not visually — it must still be rendered

```dart title="Dart"

import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {

  try {

    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<p>visible</p><div aria-hidden="true">still shown</div><p>also visible</p>', options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
